name: occurrence-report
title: Occurrence report
for_each: select id, ref from reports where kind = 'occurrence' and class in ('incident', 'serious', 'accident') order by ref

sections.title: The occurrence
sections.sql: select ref, title, occurred_local as occurred, base, country, aircraft, class, category, reporter, status, description from v_reports where id = $1

sections.title: Notices owed to the regulator
sections.sql: select authority, kind, due_local as due, standing, sent_local as sent, reference, rule from v_notifications where report_id = $1 order by due_at

sections.title: Investigation
sections.sql: select investigator, investigation_due, investigated_on, root_cause, outcome from v_reports where id = $1

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select ref, description, owner, due_on, status, effective from v_actions where report_id = $1 order by ref

name: hazard-assessment
title: Hazard and risk assessment
for_each: select id, ref from hazards where status = 'open' order by ref

sections.title: Hazard
sections.sql: select h.ref, h.title, h.area, v.owner, v.change, h.description, v.risk, v.band, v.last_reviewed, v.review_due from hazards h join v_hazards v on v.id = h.id where h.id = $1

sections.title: Assessments
sections.note: Likelihood 1 (extremely improbable) to 5 (frequent); severity A (catastrophic) to E (negligible).
sections.sql: select ra.assessed_on, ra.likelihood::text || ra.severity as risk, risk_band(ra.likelihood, ra.severity) as band, ra.controls from risk_assessments ra where ra.hazard_id = $1 order by ra.assessed_on

sections.title: Reports linked
sections.sql: select ref, occurred_local as occurred, title, class, status from v_reports where hazard_id = $1 order by occurred_at

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select ref, description, owner, due_on, status, effective from v_actions where hazard_id = $1 order by ref

name: audit-report
title: Audit report
for_each: select id, ref from audits where done_on is not null order by ref

sections.title: Audit
sections.sql: select au.ref, au.title, au.area, b.name as base, p.name as auditor, au.done_on, au.summary from audits au left join bases b on b.id = au.base_id left join people p on p.id = au.auditor_id where au.id = $1

sections.title: Findings and actions
sections.sql: select f.ref, f.level, f.description, (select string_agg(a.ref || ' ' || a.status || ' due ' || a.due_on, '; ') from actions a where a.finding_id = f.id) as actions from findings f where f.audit_id = $1 order by f.ref

name: safety-meeting-pack
title: Safety meeting pack
for_each: select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid as id, to_char(current_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as name

sections.title: Regulator notices
sections.sql: select ref, authority, kind, due_local as due, standing, sent_local as sent from v_notifications where $1::uuid is not null and (standing in ('overdue', 'due') or sent_at > now() - interval '30 days') order by due_at

sections.title: Highest risks
sections.sql: select ref, title, risk, band, open_actions, owner from v_hazards where $1::uuid is not null and status = 'open' and band in ('intolerable', 'tolerable') order by band_rank, risk

sections.title: Reports in the last 30 days
sections.sql: select ref, kind, occurred_local as occurred, base, title, class, status from v_reports where $1::uuid is not null and reported_at > now() - interval '30 days' order by occurred_at

sections.title: Actions late or waiting to be verified
sections.sql: select ref, description, owner, due_on, status, days_overdue, days_unverified from v_actions where $1::uuid is not null and ((status = 'open' and due_on < current_date) or status = 'done') order by due_on

sections.title: Safety performance indicators
sections.sql: select code, name, reports, rate_per_1000, target_per_1000, alert_per_1000 from v_spis where $1::uuid is not null order by code
